## This week

Parametric knowledge ends at the training cutoff; retrieval augmentation adds a non-parametric store. Embeddings and cosine similarity, the chunk–index–retrieve–inject pipeline, and the turn from "always retrieve" to retrieval as a tool (agentic RAG, Self-RAG). The final project's retriever starts here.
